title: Any size of array
description:
The size of a `std::array` is part of its type, so `std::array<int, 3>` and `std::array<int, 5>` are different types. To accept any size, the size becomes a template parameter.

Write a template `sumOf` that takes a `const std::array<T, N>&` and returns the sum of its elements (type `T`).
hints: The template has two parameters, a type and a size: `template <typename T, std::size_t N>` and then `T sumOf(const std::array<T, N>& values)`.
Start the total with `T total{};` (zero for numbers) and add each element.
